That defect is fixed (CRLF normalisation in tools/beta/live/nuxel_live.py, this session).  The handset DID return to Nuxel: the non-charger baseline docs/beta-finalization/live/evidence/baseline-20261016T222451+0200 shows 41/41 frames verified with androidboot.mode absent, sec_touchscreen registered and nuxel-wayland/nuxel-wl-fb/nuxel-button-manager/nuxel-touch-arm/seatd all active.
